description: Returns the draw.io diagram generation reference as Markdown. Format "xml": styles, the layout grid, edges, containers, swimlanes, layers, tags, metadata, dark mode, the layout and routing passes, and the well-formedness rules for create_diagram's xml. Format "mermaid": the header keyword and syntax hints for every Mermaid type draw.io supports, flowchart styling and the ELK layout. Call it once per format and conversation, before the first diagram in that format; the reference stays valid for the rest of the conversation.

format.description: Which reference to return: "xml" or "mermaid", matching the create_diagram parameter you will use.

name: get_drawio_reference
title: Get draw.io Reference
